omni_folk_teacher_site = { has_owner = yes OR = { has_building = mage_tower_building omni_folk_hut_site = yes } }

omni_folk_accessible_site = { omni_folk_teacher_site = yes OR = { owner = $COUNTRY$ controller = $COUNTRY$ $COUNTRY$ = { has_military_access = prev.owner } } }

# Character scope. No mage or academy qualification is required to learn.
omni_character_can_learn_folk = {
 is_alive = yes
 is_adult = yes
 NOR = {
  has_trait = brain_damaged
  has_trait = goblin_trait
  has_variable = on_orc_adventure
  has_variable = on_omni_adventure
 }
}

# Event-host scope. Rechecked both when showing a lesson and before charging.
omni_folk_can_learn = {
 exists = scope:omni_folk_teacher
 exists = scope:omni_city_visitor
 exists = scope:omni_folk_tutor
 scope:omni_folk_tutor = { is_alive = yes }
 scope:omni_folk_teacher = {
  omni_folk_source_$SPELL$ = yes
  omni_folk_accessible_site = { COUNTRY = scope:omni_city_visitor.employer }
 }
 scope:omni_city_visitor = {
  omni_character_can_learn_folk = yes
  wealth >= 50
  NOT = { omni_knows_spell = { SPELL = $SPELL$ } }
  OR = {
   location = { this = scope:omni_folk_teacher }
   any_character_unit = {
    OR = { is_army = yes is_navy = yes }
    unit_location = { this = scope:omni_folk_teacher }
   }
  }
 }
}

# Character scope.
omni_character_has_folk_teacher = {
 is_alive = yes exists = employer
 OR = {
  location = { omni_folk_accessible_site = { COUNTRY = root.employer } }
  any_character_unit = { OR = { is_army = yes is_navy = yes } unit_location = { omni_folk_accessible_site = { COUNTRY = root.employer } } }
 }
}

# Character scope.
omni_gui_character_has_folk_teacher = {
 is_alive = yes exists = employer
 OR = {
  location = { omni_folk_accessible_site = { COUNTRY = scope:omni_gui_character.employer } }
  any_character_unit = { OR = { is_army = yes is_navy = yes } unit_location = { omni_folk_accessible_site = { COUNTRY = scope:omni_gui_character.employer } } }
 }
}
